arguments.statement: ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1/8 → KdVPlan.beta0 gamma ε ≤ KdVPlan.ag gamma ∧ KdVPlan.ag gamma ≤ 1+gamma ∧ 0 < 1+gamma-KdVPlan.beta0 gamma ε ∧ gamma ≤ (1+gamma-KdVPlan.ag gamma)/(1+gamma-KdVPlan.beta0 gamma ε)
arguments.proof:
intro ε he he8
rcases lt_trichotomy gamma (1/2) with hg | hg | hg
· simp only [KdVPlan.beta0, KdVPlan.ag, if_pos hg]
  have hd : 0 < 1+gamma-(2*gamma-3/2) := by linarith [h_H002.1]
  refine ⟨by linarith, by linarith [h_H002.1], hd, ?_⟩
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hd]
  nlinarith [sq_nonneg gamma, h_H002.1]
· have hn : ¬ gamma < 1/2 := by linarith
  simp only [KdVPlan.beta0, KdVPlan.ag, if_neg hn, if_pos hg]
  have hd : 0 < 1+gamma-(-1/2-ε) := by linarith
  refine ⟨by linarith, by linarith, hd, ?_⟩
  rw [le_div_iff₀ hd]
  nlinarith
· have hn : ¬ gamma < 1/2 := by linarith
  have hne : gamma ≠ 1/2 := ne_of_gt hg
  simp only [KdVPlan.beta0, KdVPlan.ag, if_neg hn, if_neg hne]
  refine ⟨by linarith [h_H002.2], by linarith, by linarith, ?_⟩
  rw [le_div_iff₀ (by linarith : (0:ℝ) < 1+gamma-(gamma-1))]
  nlinarith [h_H002.2]

arguments.proof:
intro f g hf hg k
have hf' : Summable (fun j : ℤ => ‖f j‖^2) := by simpa [KdVPlan.MemH, KdVPlan.weight] using hf
have hg' : Summable (fun j : ℤ => ‖g j‖^2) := by simpa [KdVPlan.MemH, KdVPlan.weight] using hg
have hgk : Summable (fun j : ℤ => ‖g (k-j)‖^2) := hg'.comp_injective (by intro x y h; omega)
apply Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun j => mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (norm_nonneg _)) _ (hf'.add hgk)
intro j
nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖f j‖-‖g (k-j)‖), norm_nonneg (f j), norm_nonneg (g (k-j))]

helper.statement: ∀ (a t : ℝ) (f w : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.MemH 0 f → KdVPlan.MemH 0 w → KdVPlan.stage a t f f-KdVPlan.stage a t w w = KdVPlan.stage a t (f-w) f + KdVPlan.stage a t w (f-w)
helper.application: @yui_aux_0014 T gamma R h_H002 h_E004 h_T014 h_T015 h_T013

arguments.statement: ∀ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M → ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ a τ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ a → 0 < τ → τ ≤ 1 → a ≤ t → t ≤ a+τ → ∀ w, KdVPlan.MemH gamma w → KdVPlan.ZeroMean w → KdVPlan.hn gamma w ≤ M → KdVPlan.HB (KdVPlan.ag gamma) (KdVPlan.stage a t w w) (C*τ^gamma) ∧ KdVPlan.HB (1+gamma) (KdVPlan.stage a t w w) C
arguments.proof:
intro M hM
rcases yui_aux_0012 T gamma R h_H002 h_E004 h_T014 h_T015 h_T013 with ⟨C, hC, hb⟩
refine ⟨C*(1+M)^2, mul_pos hC (sq_pos_of_pos (by linarith)), ?_⟩
intro a τ t ha hτ hτ1 hat htt w hw hzw hwm
have h := hb a τ t hτ hτ1 hat htt w w hw hw hzw hzw
have hn : 0 ≤ KdVPlan.hn gamma w := Real.sqrt_nonneg _
constructor
· refine ⟨h.1.1, h.1.2.trans ?_⟩
  calc
    C*τ^gamma*KdVPlan.hn gamma w*KdVPlan.hn gamma w ≤ C*τ^gamma*(1+M)*(1+M) := by gcongr <;> linarith
    _ = C*(1+M)^2*τ^gamma := by ring
· refine ⟨h.2.1, h.2.2.trans ?_⟩
  calc
    C*KdVPlan.hn gamma w*KdVPlan.hn gamma w ≤ C*(1+M)*(1+M) := by gcongr <;> linarith
    _ = C*(1+M)^2 := by ring

have hK : 0 ≤ K := by dsimp [K]; positivity

refine ⟨m, ?_⟩

have hadd := yui_aux_0001 T gamma R h_H002 h_E004 h_T014 h_T015 h_T013 gamma (f-w) w hh.1 hw
have hf : KdVPlan.MemH gamma f := by simpa only [sub_add_cancel] using hadd.2.1
have hnf : KdVPlan.hn gamma f ≤ 1+KdVPlan.hn gamma w := by
  have h := hadd.2.2
  rw [sub_add_cancel] at h
  exact h.trans (add_le_add (hh.2.trans (min_le_left 1 η)) le_rfl)
have hzf : KdVPlan.ZeroMean f := by
  unfold KdVPlan.ZeroMean at *
  simp [f, KdVPlan.cutoff, hzw]
have hzd : KdVPlan.ZeroMean (f-w) := by

  rw [hzf, hzw, sub_self]
have hf0 := (h_T013.2.2.2.1 0 gamma f h_H002.1.le hf).1
have hw0 := (h_T013.2.2.2.1 0 gamma w h_H002.1.le hw).1
have hdiff := yui_aux_0014 T gamma R h_H002 h_E004 h_T014 h_T015 h_T013 a t f w hf0 hw0
have H₁ := hb (f-w) f hh.1 hf hzd hzf
have H₂ := hb w (f-w) hw hh.1 hzw hzd
have H := yui_aux_0001 T gamma R h_H002 h_E004 h_T014 h_T015 h_T013 β _ _ H₁.1 H₂.1
change KdVPlan.HB β (KdVPlan.stage a t f f-KdVPlan.stage a t w w) ε
rw [hdiff]
refine ⟨H.2.1, le_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_lt (H.2.2.trans (add_le_add H₁.2 H₂.2)) ?_)⟩
